title: Nice Commands
description:
This mod adds essential Commands for you're Minecraft World 
(note: you can also troll you're friends)
body:
## This Mod adds a lot of useful Commands
- **/Trash** — Opens an empty chest UI for deleting items.
- **/Chest** — Virtual personal chest; **subcommands**: add, open, delete.
- **/Backpack**, **/bp** — Personal backpack.
- **/sharedbackpack**, **/abp** — Global shared backpack.
- **/sethome**, **/home** — Home system
- **/tpa**, **/tpaccept**, **/tpdeny** — Teleport requests between players.
- **/tot**, **/death** — Teleport to last death location.
- **/isee <radius>** — Highlights monsters within the radius (glow effect).</radius>
- **/troll** — Troll mechanics:
  - **fakelag** <player> — Target player gets short rubber-banding delays.
  - **stone** — stepping on a Stonecutter causes damage.
  - **swap** <player1> <player2> — Swaps the positions of two players.
- **/invsee** <player> — Opens another player's real inventory live (shared, editable).
- **/hat** — Wears the held item as a hat.
- **/list** — Lists available mod commands.
